title: crataegus monogyna subsp. intermedia
intro: Crataegus monogyna subsp. intermedia, commonly known as Midland hawthorn, is a subspecies of hawthorn tree native to Europe. This plant has been traditionally used to support cardiovascular health, with potential benefits including reducing blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Midland hawthorn include vasodilation and antioxidant activity, which may help to protect against cardiac disease and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), as well as triterpenoids and organic acids.
